Overview

Mulhouse is a city in Grand Est with a population of 109,000. An Alsatian industrial city with a rich textile and automotive heritage, home to the famous Cité de l’Automobile museum. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
